description: This file defines an interface 'IClusterConnectionStatusObserver' in the Orleans namespace, which provides methods for receiving notifications regarding the status of a cluster connection, including gateway count changes and connection loss events.

classes.name: IClusterConnectionStatusObserver
classes.description: Interface that receives notifications about the status of the cluster connection, including gateway count changes and connection loss.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies this observer that the number of connected gateways has changed.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies this observer that the connection to the cluster has been lost.
